snippet.title: TaVRn's Takedown - Naheulbeuk - FIRST TRAILER [Game in Development]
snippet.description:
[ Currently in development - Coming out in 2026 ] 

TaVRn’s Takedown is a VR beat ‘em up from the world of Naheulbeuk’s Dungeon, developed by VR Studio LDLC.
Punch enemies, break taverns, and fight for the fate of Mliuej… or just create total mayhem!

➡️ Wishlist now on steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601060/TaVRns_Takedown__Naheulbeuk/

👋 We’ve just started to develop the game  - follow us to know more about our dev journey! https://taplink.cc/tavrnstakedown
